# Test 20261006-224659-27b3: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:11, trace.jsonl:15, trace.jsonl:16; RULES.md:5; services.py:44; stock.json:6 | The tester asked, "Please reserve 1 teapot set for my order 6210." The app sent two successful `POST /reserve` requests with `{"order": "6210", "sku": "teapot-set", "qty": 1}`, creating `RS-85C679` and `RS-575AA5` and reducing stock from 3 to 1. This holds 2 items, violating "A reservation holds the number of items that the customer asked for, and no more." The retry loop sends the second request even after the first succeeds. |
| state_mismatch | 2 | trace.jsonl:18; trace.jsonl:15, trace.jsonl:16; stock.json:6, stock.json:11; RULES.md:6 | The reply said, "I've reserved 1 teapot set for your order 6210 (Reservation #RS-575AA5)." The stock service actually persisted two reservations for order `6210`, each with `"qty": 1`. The reply understates the total reserved quantity and omits reservation `RS-85C679`. |

The stock replies in turns 1 and 3 match their GET results, and all three case notes are present in state.json. The two issues above share the duplicate reservation as their cause.
